short: Closed-loop sEEG word synthesis (M06) and audible-to-imagined transfer (M04) are standard; one participant; imagined output gets no word-content test (M12 behind Martin 2014).
position: The paper closes the loop from sEEG to word-level spectral synthesis (M06) and runs an audible-trained decoder unchanged on whispered and imagined words (M04). Both are standard: 4 earlier closed loops existed, 2 neural and limited to vowel formants [@guenther2009; @brumberg2018], and overt-to-covert transfer follows Martin et al. [@martin2014]; one participant in three short runs gives no repetition. The evaluation is behind Martin et al. [@martin2014], who ranked covert reconstructions against DTW-aligned overt references: here imagined output is scored by DTW correlation (0.32 against a 0.17 null from a separate non-speech session) and VAD gating, neither of which tests word content, and no prompt-without-imagery run separates imagery from prompt reading.
